results.name: Three clients instantiate visible remote bodies on the same build
Real C input switches ordinary third and first person
Mouse wheel zoom is applied to the running camera
Chat focus blocks WASD and camera bindings
Actual Korean DM reaches B while C receives no chat payload
Reaction and author edit propagate to the other recipient
File chooser transfers real file bytes and verified download matches sender SHA-256
Chunk transfer cancels, resumes at its saved offset, and leaves another player responsive
PNG bytes are decoded and previewed by the recipient
Closing messenger restores movement without replaying typed keys
An undownloaded file is visibly unavailable after its actual provider disconnects
